parameters.name: feature_x
parameters.description: Feature to use as the predictor on the x-axis of the scatter plot.

parameters.name: fit_intercept
parameters.description: Whether the model should include an intercept (bias) term.

parameters.name: learning_rate
parameters.description: Step size for each gradient descent update. Smaller values are more stable but converge slower.

parameters.name: test_size
parameters.description: Fraction of the dataset held out for evaluation.

parameters.name: random_state
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducible train/test splits.
